title: A paused film in a background tab may drop out of the 60 s window
notes: jellyfin-web reports progress every 10 s (setInterval 1e4); a throttled hidden tab may report less often. A wider window (minutes) costs nothing but snapshot size, since revocation exposure is the refresh interval. Unverified that throttling reaches 60 s. Promoted to JS-103, done (#139).
